title: When loneliness closes the room in after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The heart feels unaccompanied even when people are nearby. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru joins belonging to remembrance, Sangat, and the nearness of the One. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: Neediness is not rejected here. It is brought honestly into the Guru's care. Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone.
actionPrompt: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
